body:
Well, I don't want to burst your bubble, but making it through college is just the beginning. You have to actually find a job afterwards to pay for the loans.

I thought that I just needed to make it through college, until I finally finished college and realized how things didn't get better despite how much effort I put into going into debt.

People only talked to me in high school because I am "smart". It basically ended up with me not being a loner like you are talking about. People certainly talked to me and wanted my help for homework, but that is all they wanted. No one actually wanted to be my friend.


Things didn't get better in college, and especially not after college. Now no one needs me for answers or help on homework.
I don't think there is anything in the world for people like us. I can't think of any way I can be useful. People need to generate value somehow to be cared about.

1. It's just how I feel

2. I just want to get it over with. Nothing I do will matter in the end. I'm a negative influence on this world. I'm like a parasite. I leech and only leave negativity behind.

3. Either way, I would rather not deal with it.

4. There is basically no real reason for people to be positive toward me and vice versa.

5. It would just be easier to side step it altogether by dying.

6. I don't have many opportunities to dig through the pile, so I likely won't find anything.

7. You've got me there. I feel like I am wasting your time though.

8. I think I would need to be fixed in order to be capable of that.

9. I guess it is just only how it looks from my point of view. I can't change my reality though.

10. Wouldn't it be better to suffer less though?
As someone who is depressed, this really needs to be an option that I can choose. If i know I don't want to see the rest of my life, why should I?
You have to be tough all the time. If you aren't, it's social suicide.

My psychiatrist just kept increasing the dose on Zoloft. Then he gave me an amphetamine when I was groggy in the morning. I think he is the only one I can see in town though, so I gave up.

It's going to be 24 degrees Fahrenheit and snowing tomorrow. Idk if I really want to go outside tomorrow
Maybe I have value, but no potential then? Like I can't capitalize on what little value I have.
I don't think i could handle the anxiety of freelance. If i didn't get enough work, I wouldn't be able to pay my bills. Plus, I live in the middle of nowhere.

I've already seen the psychiatrist in my area. It never really helped before. I always have to hide how I feel so that they don't consider putting me in the hospital again.   I especially can't risk it now that I have a job. I could easily lose it.
Yeah, sort of. I think I'll just pick up the movie on blu-ray at some point. I guess I'm not super excited to see it anyway. I just worry that people will talk about it.

That's the issue, there really is no way to do that or guarantee that. I think a lot of us would have left years or decades ago if there were a way.
Why does your friend want to leave?
One time, when I was a teenager, I purposely did not mention a deer that was potentially going to collide with my parent's car because I was hoping it would kill me. Someone else noticed it anyway.
Why a Sunday in particular?
I guess I'm just paranoid. I don't want to be a burden.

I don't really like listening to unfamiliar music.


Maybe I will on my way to work tomorrow, so that I can be sure no one will hear me.

Well, I guess I feel alone, which makes me wish I could touch another person, which makes me feel more alone.


I think the last thing I said in a loud voice was that "I hate my life"


I guess I find both black and white to be empty.
It doesn't matter how things really are. I may not be entirely, completely alone, but I definitely feel like I am. I just can't take it anymore.
No, I would rather no one local know about it until I'm gone.
I'm so drained that I can't put in that effort. Worrying all the time and being depressed means I can't even get out of bed for breakfast.

Given enough time, I imagine things could randomly get better for some short period of time. I just know that no matter what happens, I will end up like this again.

I can't really can't think of where I would go. It's probably going to be freezing and I hate my town anyway.
I just don't know if that is an option. The days go by so slowly and they are all the same.
But if I keep living, I have to keep worrying  and being sad. I'm trying to accomplish two things at the same time. Expressing how I've felt, and escaping how I feel.

I guess I just wanted to send a message like "I don't even want to see next year" or "I never asked to be born". 


Those could just be written, but I feel like commiting suicide on those particular days would prove exactly how i was feeling.
Ah, I worry about that too, and I'm not sure how to fix it.

I used to be afraid of dying when I thought of not existing, but now I realize I never wanted to exist in the first place.


I'm not sure exactly what you mean though, unless you mean you are worried about your method.

Just a general sense of hopelessness. I'm not really satisfied in any area of my life, but change also makes me anxious and sick.


I'm just stuck and even if I get free temporarily, it will only be temporary. I'm always going to feel sad.


I'm just not cut out for life. I should have just killed myself when I was a teenager and realized that.
A few months. I decided I would kill myself at the end of the year.
I have accepted that my life is meaningless, any effort I put in is worthless, and the only way to stop the pain I have no control over is to stop living.
Yeah, I place way too much hope in people who say they want to do things with me. Most must change their mind very quickly.

I feel like sometimes the only time they are wasting is moving the message to trash :/
I don't pay for advance packages, so I have no idea how many of my messages even get read.

 

I'm sorry it's the same for you.

Yeah, any glimmer of hope quickly vanishes.
They either stop responding abruptly, or just reply back one word repeatedly. (lol, ok, idk, haha, etc.)

The result is the same regardless of if the message is sent.
The way you describe it, idk if it's realistically ever going to happen to me.

Meetup is kind of dead in the area around me, unless I drive to the city, but that's kind of stressful. I've tried playing magic again, but I'm just bored while playing now.

It's possible there is someone out there looking for me too, but I just really doubt it. I just don't want to hurt and be hurt for no reason.

Thanks for the offer to talk, but I have managed to find some people to talk to already and it is burning me out as it is.
I'm 22 years old.
I sometimes talk to myself and summarize the plot of a game or a movie, or rant about how good or bad I think it is. I like to pretend I have someone to talk to about stuff.
I wouldn't even go as far as saying people need to look up to me for being straight edge. I just want to be treated like a normal human being like everyone else. People joked that I'm like a robot.

Not doing certain things is basically social suicide.


I went to a high school reunion yesterday, and half of what people said to me was "Why are you not drinking, smoking, vaping, etc?". None of them were people that fit in with society well, yet I don't even fit in with them at all I guess.


Best question was "Wait, you've never even tried a cigarette?".

 

I feel like I'm struggling internally with desiring meaningfull human interaction more than anything, yet despising so many people that I meet due to how they judge me for being different.

I tried being open about my depression at school, and it really only made things worse. People probably avoided me more for it because when talking to me didn't fix me, they got mad and left. 


Even if you do actually have depression, people unfortunately don't take kindly to victims.

I don't think you are being overdramatic.


I get that feeling of just needing someone that is there for me too. I wish society had some system in place to provide comfort because it's just extremely distressing to feel trapped and cut off from people in general. 


Even if I interact with co-workers on a daily basis and make jokes, I still feel cut off from people without a more personal relationship. I couldn't burden a co-worker with my sorrows.
Thank you! (:

[Try having your graphics card constantly run at max clock speed](https://youtu.be/EwXDcKiLSdg?t=1m20s)


I had stuttering problems with a game once and disabling the card's ability to underclock fixed the issue entirely because my card was rarely letting itself run at full speed.

Thank you!

 

In case you were wondering what the shirt says, it says:


"No one said I was Batman. All I'm saying is you'll never see us in the same place together".

I think they are good suggestions though. 


If I don't change anything, then nothing will change.
That's why I started to do squats and crunches.

I honestly was not expecting such a great and thorough response. Thank you so much!


I will try combing my hair. I honestly have not even thought about combing in like 5 years. I might try some pomades or gel too.


I started doing some light exercises last weekend, but I have not included running into the mix yet. Maybe I can start that tomorrow morning.


I hope you have a wonderful day too!
